Provides a resource to manage MongoDB instance elastic CPU scale-up.

> **NOTE:** This resource is used to manually enable elastic CPU scale-up for MongoDB instances. When the resource is created, `ScaleUpDBInstanceCpu` is called to scale up the CPU. When the resource is destroyed, `ScaleDownDBInstanceCpu` is called to disable the elastic CPU scale-up and shrink back.

> **NOTE:** Suggest using instances with `machineType` values of `HIO10G` to operate CPU elastic scaling, and if CPU elastic scaling is required, it is not recommended to actually configure the instance CPU value.

			Password:      pulumi.String("Password@2026"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = mongodb.NewScaleUpDbInstanceCpu(ctx, "example", &mongodb.ScaleUpDbInstanceCpuArgs{
			InstanceId: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			ExtraCpu:   pulumi.Int(2),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

	})

## Import



MongoDB instance elastic CPU scale-up can be imported using the instance id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Mongodb/scaleUpDbInstanceCpu:ScaleUpDbInstanceCpu example cmgo-p8vnipr5
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
